summary: Iteration 196 testing complete. All frontend workout popup features verified: start-workout-btn is directly on page (not in grey card), full-screen popup with dark background, series counter, rep count, exercise steps reminder, rest timer with ring animation, skip button, Bravo completion screen, and close functionality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workout popup feature fully implemented and tested. The popup is a full-screen overlay (position:fixed, inset:0, zIndex:9999) with dark background (#0A0A0F). It has 3 states: set screen (workout-set-screen), rest screen (workout-rest-screen), finished screen (workout-finished-screen). Exercise has 10 sets, 21 reps, 130s rest.

start_workout_btn_not_in_grey_card.details: Button is directly on page with white parent background (rgb(255, 255, 255)), not inside grey card (rgb(244, 244, 245)). Button has black background (#111).

full_screen_popup_dark_background.details: Popup has position:fixed, inset:0px, zIndex:9999, background:rgb(10, 10, 15) - full-screen dark overlay.

series_counter_display.details: Set screen shows 'SERIE X SUR Y' format (e.g., 'Serie 1 sur 10'). Counter updates correctly as sets are completed.

rep_count_display.details: Large rep count (21) displayed with 'repetitions' label below.

exercise_steps_reminder.details: Steps reminder section shows 'RAPPEL DES ETAPES' with numbered steps (1-4 for Squat exercise).

serie_terminee_button.details: Button shows 'Serie terminee' text. Clicking it triggers rest timer for sets 1-9, and 'Terminer l'exercice' for set 10.

rest_timer_ring_animation.details: Rest screen shows SVG ring timer with 2 circles (background + progress). Timer shows countdown (e.g., 2:10 for 130s rest). Ring has glow animation.

skip_rest_button.details: Skip button shows 'Passer le repos' text. Clicking it skips rest and advances to next set.

bravo_completion_screen.details: After completing all 10 sets, shows 'Bravo !' message with checkmark icon, exercise name ('Squat termine'), and stats ('10 series x 21 reps').

fermer_button.details: 'Fermer' button displayed on completion screen. Clicking it closes popup and returns to exercise detail page.

close_button_x.details: X button (workout-close-btn) visible in top-left corner. Clicking it closes popup at any time.

WorkoutPopup_component.details: Component at lines 438-545 implements full-screen workout flow with 3 states: set screen, rest screen, finished screen. Uses proper data-testid attributes for testing.

start_workout_btn_placement.details: Button at lines 297-304 is rendered directly in content area (not inside a grey card). Has proper styling with black background (#111) and white text.

rest_timer_implementation.details: Rest timer uses SVG ring with strokeDasharray for progress animation. Timer countdown implemented with setInterval in startRest function.
